svg.font-family: TeX Gyre Heros, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Worked example: a 215 kWh / 194 kW battery-buffered charger on a 44 kW connection
Illustrative simulation: 30-minute sessions at 194 kW; battery starts full; losses and usable-window limits ignored.
Three back-to-back sessions drain it; recovering 215 kWh at 44 kW takes about five hours.
